text:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED — P1 — inference-gateway | 5xx error-rate spike detected (12.3% over 1m, baseline 0.4%) — region: eu-west-1 — link: https://pager.redwood.example/incidents/INC-3172
Alex (oncall): acked. I'm looking.
Alex (oncall): quick check — dashboard shows 5xx type = 502 from gateway->model-backend, latencies also rising.
Liz (infra): noticed a deployment from 1774998000 to pool-gw-eu about 6m ago. Could be related.
Alex (oncall): copying runbook snippet. Steps I'm doing now: 1) divert traffic to fallback model variant 2) scale gateway replicas 3) capture debug logs.
Alex (oncall): running curl to health endpoints to confirm:
```
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://eu.gateway.redwood/api/v1/health
```
Alex (oncall): health returned 200 from two nodes, but the request path /v1/generate is returning 502 from specific worker ip 10.4.22.11.
IncidentBot: escalation threshold reached (5m unresolved) — paging senior oncall Sam.
Sam (oncall-next): I'm awake, joining. Can you share the logs filter you used?
Alex (oncall): tailing gateway logs and grepping error id:
```
grep "error=502" /var/log/gateway/*.log | tail -n 200
```
Alex (oncall): here's a sample stack trace snippet (redacted):
```
error: upstream connection reset while streaming, connection_id=0x7f9b
  at net/socket.c:234
  model-backend: Read failed while sending chunked response
```
Liz (infra): I rolled back the recent pool-gw-eu deployment in canary 2 -> rollback triggered. Observability: node 10.4.22.11 being drained.
Alex (oncall): rerouting 30% of traffic to secondary region via routing flag `region_fallback: true`.
```
# temporary routing override
PATCH /api/v1/routing/overrides
{"service":"inference-gateway","region":"eu-west-2","percent":30}
```
CustomerImpactBot: estimated impacted requests: 4.2k failures in last 5m (0.7% of tenant requests). Top affected customers: corpX, mobile-app-prod, search-indexer.
Jordan (cto): please prioritize customer-facing retries and quick rollback if instability persists. Any confirmed data loss?
Alex (oncall): no persisted data loss. Failures are transient 5xx. Retrying upstream yields success for ~60% on immediate retry.
Sam (oncall-next): I've spun up a hotfix model-backend instance with debug symbols and attached to a test route. Can we confirm whether this is model runtime crash vs networking?
Alex (oncall): initial heap and QPS look normal on other nodes. The common pattern is connection reset during chunked streaming. Might be kernel-level or grpc/proxy bug.
Liz (infra): kernel updates were rolled to two nodes in pool-gw-eu in the last hour. I am checking nodes for OOM/killed processes.
Alex (oncall): mitigation list (in progress):
- rollback canary (done)
- drain and replace 10.4.22.11 (in progress)
- enable region fallback (done)
- increase gateway replicas + autoscale min (in progress)
- capture gzipped logs and upload to incident bucket

Alex (oncall): uploading logs to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-3172/logs.tar.gz — link: https://s3.redwood.example/INC-3172/logs.tar.gz
Sam (oncall-next): after rollback + drain we see 5xx down to 3.1% from 12.3% in eu-west-1. Good progress. Keep monitoring.
PagerBot: note — PagerDuty incident INC-3172 updated: status = acknowledged -> investigating.
CustomerImpactBot: update: failed requests dropping, estimated customer error-rate impact now 0.25% across global traffic. No SEV1 customer complaints opened yet.
Jordan (cto): thank you. Please prepare a short post-incident note for customer success if we confirm rollback caused reduced errors.
Alex (oncall): will do. Handoff: my shift ends in 25m. Sam will take post-mitigation ownership. Key items for next oncall:
- confirm drain/replacement completion for 10.4.22.11
- verify no kernel panics on recently updated nodes
- run regression test suite for chunked streaming paths
Sam (oncall-next): taking handoff. I'll keep this P1 open until 4 hours with periodic updates.
Alex (oncall): leaving a short timeline in thread and marking the incident channel. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: incident INC-3172 assigned to Sam (oncall-next) — reminder in 30m for status update.
PagerBot: resolved? not yet — incident remains investigating until post-mortem and SLA check.
Sam (oncall-next): adding a note to the incident: follow-up tickets for infra patch validation + permanent routing fallback strategy.
Alex (oncall): final note before I go: observed error-rate spike coincided with 3k rps burst to model-backend from search-indexer; consider rate-limiting client or adding ingress backpressure.
Sam (oncall-next): noted. I'll run canary load test in eu-west-1 after drain completes.
Alex (oncall): offline now. thanks.
